inputs.checklistItemText: Grading plan shows drainage slopes toward building from oil-filled transformer pad location (liquid flow must be away from building)
inputs.question: On this grading plan, identify all transformer pad locations. For each transformer pad, determine the direction of ground surface drainage/slope as indicated by the contour lines and spot elevations. Indicate whether surface drainage flows away from buildings or toward buildings. Also identify the type of transformer equipment (oil-filled or dry-type) if specified anywhere on the electrical or utility plans.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for feature identification (transformer pad locations), drainage direction determination from contour interpretation, and equipment-type labeling—all visual recognition and reading tasks. While the requirement concerns a measurement-like concept (drainage slope direction), the agent question is fundamentally about presence, location, and label readout rather than quantitative distance/clearance measurement between two features.
